correctness.rationale: With n independent endpoint pairs, all 2n ranks give a uniform matching. The anchor projections are pX=2t(1-t) and pN=t^2+2l(1-r). Their exact triangle integrals give covariance of projections zero and individual projection variances 1/45. Same-pair crossing/nesting indicators have covariance -1/9, distinct single-overlap terms vanish, and disjoint terms are independent, proving Cov=-n(n-1)/18. The same overlap count proves Var=n(n-1)(n+3)/45. The bounded Hoeffding degenerate remainder has O(n^2) second moment, versus an n^3 leading scale, establishing joint iid Gaussian limits via the multivariate CLT. The independent standard-library checker passed 75 exact assertions, exhaustive through n=7; finite cases do not replace proof.

value.rationale: The exact negative correlation -5/[2(n+3)] and independent bivariate Gaussian limit jointly resolve the finite-versus-asymptotic dependence of two canonical matching pattern counts. This is not a marginal theorem: the key structural condition is exact orthogonality of distinct Hoeffding projections, yielding a natural full covariance matrix including alignments. The n^-1 decorrelation rate is exact and nontrivial, making the result useful for joint asymptotic inference.
